description: Authenticated start page. Summarizes the signed-in principal, available teams, current active-team selection, and direct account/team-management actions without loading projects or operational domains.

Identity settings route for public profile details, immutable username display, verified-email lifecycle, scoped-reauthenticated password setup/change, and explicit provider linking/unlinking without mixing session, notification, theme, or deletion concerns.

Personal-theme manager that lists immutable built-ins and private user-created themes, validates guided light/dark palettes and WCAG contrast, and supports create, rename, edit, and guarded deletion. Theme activation remains exclusively in the authenticated shell selector.

Destructive account workflow that loads authoritative ownership/admin blockers, requires the exact confirmation phrase and a five-minute one-use scoped reauthentication grant or current password, then revokes sessions and purges account-owned identity data.

Notification preference editor with one account-wide email cadence, a canonical content-type selection inherited across authorized projects, optional exact-replacement project overrides, and browser-derived IANA timezone capture. In-app visibility remains immediate.

Session collection for the signed-in principal. It identifies the current browser session, permits idempotent revocation of other sessions, and directs current-device termination through the CSRF-protected logout action.
Bounded active-team capacity domain landing page.
Bounded active-team hosting domain landing page.
Bounded active-team knowledge domain landing page.
Bounded active-team catalog and billing domain landing page.
Bounded active-team project domain landing page.

Lists teams available to the principal, identifies the active team and membership role, and exposes create, select, edit, member-management, and delete actions when the principal has sufficient authority.
Authenticated operational team overview with bounded domain summaries and recent audit activity.
pathParameters: [teamId] identifies the team selected for a protected management action.

description: Protected team deletion workflow. Resolves the requested team, verifies an owner or project-lead role, loads deletion blockers, requires an exact confirmation phrase, and deletes only when no blocking records remain.
pathParameters: [teamId] identifies the team selected for a protected management action.

description: Protected team settings form. Resolves and selects the requested team, verifies management authority, displays current identity fields, validates submitted changes, and persists updates through the Admin API facade.
pathParameters: [teamId] identifies the team selected for a protected management action.

description: Protected membership workspace for listing team members, sending invitations, changing member roles, and removing members. Owner/project-lead authorization and API last-owner protections govern mutations.
pathParameters: [teamId] identifies the team selected for a protected management action.

description: Explicit, membership-validated active-team preference selection.
Authenticated team-creation form. Validates the new team identity, creates it through the API facade, records it as the active team, and continues into the retained team-management surface.
Hidden configured-provider callback with one-time state, nonce, PKCE, and safe redirect.
pathParameters: [provider] is one configured identity-provider identifier from the canonical provider registry.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; configured provider; one-time database state; nonce and PKCE validation; safe return URL

description: Auth continuation page shown after registration or password-reset requests. Explains which message to expect, preserves only a validated return target, and redirects an already authenticated principal to the app.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; safe return URL

description: Consumes an email-confirmation token through the authentication API. On success it establishes the resulting session and follows the validated return target; invalid or expired tokens render a recoverable failure state.
policyNeeds: valid one-time confirmation token; anonymous or signed-in principal; safe return URL

description: Signed-in approval screen for CLI/device authorization. Displays the requesting device context, submits approval to the auth service, and reports approved, invalid, expired, or denied states.
policyNeeds: signed-in principal; valid pending device request

description: Anonymous password-reset request form. Accepts an account email, calls the reset-request API, and transitions to the check-email page without exposing whether an account exists.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; safe return URL

description: CSRF-protected POST action that revokes the current web session, clears the API access cookie, and returns a 303 to sign-in. GET performs no authentication mutation and redirects to sign-in.
policyNeeds: GET is non-mutating; POST requires signed-in session and double-submit CSRF

description: Anonymous credential-registration form for name, permanent public username, email, and password. It normalizes and checks username availability after debounce, checks privacy-safe email usability on blur/change, blocks submission until both checks succeed, repeats uniqueness validation authoritatively at submission, and directs a new account to email verification.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; safe return URL

description: Token-based password-reset form. Validates and confirms the replacement password, submits the reset token to the auth service, and returns the user to sign-in after completion.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; safe return URL

description: Credential sign-in form accepting email or username plus password. Creates the web session, preserves a safe return target, and exposes recovery and registration paths.
policyNeeds: anonymous principal only; safe return URL

description: Authenticated username-claim step for principals that do not yet have a public username. Validates namespace availability, stores the permanent username, and returns to a safe account/app destination.
policyNeeds: restricted provider-onboarding session; username not already assigned; safe return URL

description: Public team knowledge profile. Resolves a team by normalized public name and renders identity, explicitly public projects, reusable catalog items, knowledge packs, and a publication trail; authenticated members also receive the canonical role-gated team navigation while private membership and operational context remain redacted.
pathParameters: [name] is the normalized public team name.

description: Invitation redemption flow. Resolves the invite token, coordinates sign-in or registration when necessary, accepts valid invitations through the API, and reports expired, invalid, or already-used invitations.
pathParameters: [token] is the opaque invitation credential issued by the authentication API.

description: Public user knowledge profile. Normalizes the username, renders identity, expertise, and explicitly public attributed contributions, adds canonical account navigation only for the signed-in owner, redirects noncanonical names, and returns 404 for unknown active users without exposing account or membership context.
pathParameters: [username] is the normalized, globally unique public username.

description: Core homepage composed from enabled content collections. Introduces the site and surfaces recent questions, objectives, proposals, decisions, notes, people, agents, and books without a Market-owned override.

Generic top-level Core content page. Resolves an entry from the pages collection, chooses the configured content or bridge layout, renders local or published-runtime HTML, and returns the shared not-found surface when absent.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Explicit not-found page with a plain explanation and recovery links to the homepage, books library, and status content.
Public directory of configured software-agent contributors, including each agent’s name, summary, operator, runtime status, tags, and link to its profile.
Agent profile page with rendered narrative content, operator/runtime metadata, and resolved relationships to questions and objectives. Missing agents return the shared 404 presentation.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Ordered public catalog of book records showing title, summary, section metadata, landing paths, and available download links.
Long-form book reader. Resolves a book by ID or slug, renders local or published-runtime content in the reader layout, and returns a book-specific not-found state when absent.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Public contact page and Core-owned contact form for questions, feedback, collaboration notes, and issue reports. It displays submission status returned by the Core form handler.
Reverse-chronological public decision index showing title, summary, status, date, contributor, and tags for recorded accepted, rejected, deferred, or superseded choices.
Decision detail with rationale, authority, type, implementation metadata, contributor, rendered body, and links to related objectives, questions, notes, proposals, books, and superseded decisions.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Root of the public knowledge reader. Selects local Astro docs or the published content runtime and renders the root document, with explicit 404 and upstream-unavailable states.
Catch-all public knowledge reader for nested documentation paths. Resolves local or published content by the complete remaining path and distinguishes missing content from runtime unavailability.
pathParameters: [...slug] is the complete nested documentation path, including any remaining segments.

description: Public working-notes index for implementation observations, framing, and documentation decisions, loaded from the local or published notes collection.
Working-note detail with metadata and rendered local or published content. Drafts are excluded and missing notes receive a note-specific 404 state.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Public index of strategic objectives, including summaries, status/context metadata, contributors, and links into each objective record.
Objective detail with authored content, contributor, and resolved relationships to questions and books. Draft or missing objectives are not rendered.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Public directory of human contributors, describing stewardship identities and linking each person to their profile.
Human contributor profile with rendered biography/profile content and resolved relationships to questions and objectives; missing profiles return 404.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Public proposal index presenting explicit suggested changes with summaries, state, contributors, and navigation to their detailed records.
Proposal detail with authored content and relationships to objectives, questions, notes, books, decisions, and superseded proposals. Draft or missing proposals are withheld.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Public stream of research questions, showing their summaries, status/context, contributors, and links to detailed inquiry records.
Question detail with authored content, contributor information, and resolved objective/book relationships. Draft or unknown questions return the shared not-found state.
pathParameters: [slug] identifies a content entry in the route’s collection.

description: Core UI catalog used to inspect shared TreeSeed primitives across themes and viewport sizes, including buttons, badges, cards, forms, lists, details, tables, empty states, and appearance controls.
